LanguageData.RJW_UnknownEgg.label: generic insect egg
LanguageData.RJW_InsectHiveEgg.label: insectoid egg
LanguageData.RJW_MechanoidImplant.label: implanted mechanoid
LanguageData.RJW_ImplantEgg.description: Parasitic egg(s) that enter the host's body and feeds off their nutrients until ready to hatch. Just be glad they don't hatch by bursting out of your chest.
LanguageData.RJW_ImplantMech.description: A small computer that enters a host through one of their orifices. Can analyze vital signs and location data, and relay that information back to mechanoid ai.
